navigation.style: Glassmorphism header: `fixed top-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50`. Include a text logo 'Vanguard Citadel Sec' with a 'Shield' icon from lucide-react. Right side: standard nav links mapping to anchors (#about, #services, #compliance) and a primary CTA 'Contact Us' mapping to (#contact).

hero.style: Minimalist corporate hero. Two-column layout on desktop. Left: H1 'Securing Your Digital Frontier', subtitle, and dual CTAs. Right: `hero_shield_abstract` image inside a subtle rounded container or floating. Very clean, high contrast.

about_leaders.style: Section with a soft surface background (`bg-slate-50`). Present the firm as a premier cybersecurity consulting body. Dedicate a stylized two-column 'bento' block or cards for the 2 leaders: Priyanka Joshi & Abhijeet Kulkarni. Use `about_corporate_office` image as an atmospheric visual here.

services.style: Grid layout `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 lg:gap-8`. For 10 items, you could have a prominent leading item spanning 2 columns, or just a uniform grid. Use simple border cards `border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300`. Deep Navy blue icon accents. 10 Services total.

compliance.style: Use the `bg_network_texture` as a very subtle, low-opacity background (`opacity-20` on absolute inset div) over a Navy Blue background (`bg-[#0A2540]`). White text. Display standard compliance badges or text blocks in a grid.

contact.style: Clean white section. Left: Trust stats (Years of Experience, Security Assessments, Happy Clients - derived from Varutra inspiration) or Why Choose Us content. Right: Contact Form using customized Shadcn UI elements (Input, Textarea, Button).

footer.style: Simple, solid dark footer matching primary brand color. Include brand name, copyright, and standard links.

images.description: Abstract 3D geometric shield in pristine white and metallic silver. Perfect for the hero section right-side.
Modern glass architecture. Use as an accent image in the about us / leaders section.
Minimalist server racks and cloud nodes. Can be used adjacent to the services grid or inside a prominent service feature card.
Abstract network grid pattern. Use with low opacity as a background texture for the Compliance section over a deep navy blue background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and use `lucide-react` for all icons.
Use Manrope for Headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text. Load via Google Fonts.
Implement smooth scrolling for single-page navigation links (Hero, About, Services, Compliance, Contact). Ensure html, body { scroll-behavior: smooth; } is applied.
Enforce strict contrast rules. Do not use generic Inter font.
All interactive elements and key sections MUST have the `data-testid` attribute as specified.
Do NOT use pure #000000 for text. Use #0F172A (slate-900) and other slate variables.
Construct the UI exclusively using Tailwind CSS on standard HTML elements unless complex functionality dictates Shadcn (like Contact form).
Keep the aesthetic heavily corporate, authoritative, using the requested Deep Navy Blue and Silver. Avoid all neon greens or purple gradients.
